description_en: Updates the status of a HiMarket developer by developer ID. The request body specifies the target status and portal ID. A successful response returns only the requestId, code, and message, and does not return the updated developer information
description_zh: 按开发者 ID 更新 HiMarket 开发者的状态，请求体提交目标状态与门户 ID；成功响应只返回 requestId、code 与 message，不回传更新后的开发者信息
kebab_example: aliyun apig update-developer-status --developer-id dev-xxxxxxxx --portal-id portal-xxxxxxxx --status APPROVED --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDeveloperStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the developer whose status you want to update. You can obtain this ID from the data.developerId field in the CreateDeveloper or GetDeveloper response, or from the developerId field of an item in the ListDevelopers response. This path parameter is the same as the one used in DeleteDeveloper to locate the developer
parameters.help_zh: 开发者 ID，指定要更新状态的开发者。可由 CreateDeveloper 响应的 data.developerId、GetDeveloper 响应的 data.developerId 或 ListDevelopers 列表项的 developerId 获得，与 DeleteDeveloper 使用同一路径参数来定位开发者
parameters.name: developer_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the portal to which the developer belongs, which is the primary ID of the portal resource. You can obtain this ID from the portalId field in the CreatePortal response or from the portalId field of an item in the ListPortals response
parameters.help_zh: 该开发者所属门户的 Portal ID，即门户资源 Portal 的一级 ID。可由 CreatePortal 响应的 portalId 或 ListPortals 列表项的 portalId 获得
parameters.name: portal_id

parameters.help_en: The target status of the developer. Valid values: PENDING, APPROVED, and REJECTED
parameters.help_zh: 要更新的开发者状态。取值：PENDING、APPROVED、REJECTED
parameters.name: status

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the developer whose status you want to update. You can obtain this ID from the data.developerId field in the CreateDeveloper or GetDeveloper response, or from the developerId field of an item in the ListDevelopers response. This path parameter is the same as the one used in DeleteDeveloper to locate the developer

v1_parameters.name: developerId
